title: Steganography detection pipeline
steps: `file`, `exiftool`, `pngcheck`, `binwalk`, and `strings` first; record dimensions, palette, and appended bytes.
Try `zsteg -a image.png`, `steghide info/extract`, `stegseek`, and LSB bit-plane views; preserve the original.
For audio, render a spectrogram (`sox ... spectrogram`), inspect Morse/DTMF, and check metadata/cover art.
For QR/barcodes, `zbarimg`/`qrtool`; for archives, try the challenge password or a small wordlist.
falsifier: No appended data, no LSB signal, no metadata anomaly, and no audio/QR payload; the carrier may be a decoy.
